articles.title: India’s Indigenous High-Speed Train Enters Carbody Validation as 2027 Bullet Train Rollout Nears
articles.description: BEML Limited, the public-sector company developing India’s first indigenous high-speed trainsets in partnership with the Integral Coach Factory, currently has an active tender for third-party stress validation of the carbody for its standard-gauge High-Speed Train Project. BEML identifies the train as a chair-car high-speed train with a design speed of 280 kmph and operating speed of 249 kmph. articles.title: BMC School Supplies Delay Sparks BJP-Opposition Clash Over GeM Procurement Process
articles.description: A BJP-Opposition clash erupted at the BMC General Body meeting over delays in supplying 27 educational items to civic school students through the GeM portal. Shiv Sena (UBT) alleged irregularities and sought an audit, while officials said most supplies were distributed and umbrellas remained pending. BMC said procurement for next year would begin in January.
